$comment: 语法大厅 G31（V0.9 P3 进阶层，非谓语三课之二）。比喻锚点：把一个动作打包成一件「东西」。只讲初中层面辨析（enjoy/finish/practise 接 doing、介词后接 doing、动名词作主语谓语单数、to do vs doing 分工、stop/remember/forget 双接法），不堆砌复杂例外；末尾指向精修层 G46 合流。暗线：同一动词换身份换规则。全部内容原创。
title: 动名词 doing
metaphor: 把一个动作打包成一件「东西」
ketNote: KET 只在 like doing / go swimming 这类高频搭配里顺带见到动名词，不单独考。系统辨析是初中重头戏——这课为初中/PET 打底，学到就是赚到，不用焦虑。

sections.essence: -ing 把动作打包成一件「东西」：能当主语、能当宾语，介词后只收它。
sections.why: 中文里动作当东西用毫不费力：「游泳很有趣」「我喜欢画画」——「游泳」「画画」直接坐进名词的位置。英语的动词不行：光溜溜的 swim 只能当主奏报时，要想当「东西」用，得先打个包——加上 -ing 封条：Swimming is fun. I like drawing. 打包之后它就是一件安静的物品：可以当主语（谓语按单数算）、当宾语、跟在介词后面。哪些动词爱收打包件？enjoy、finish、practise、keep、mind——多半是「正在做或已成习惯」的事。它和 G30 的 to do 正好分工：to do 指向还没做的（想做、打算做），doing 偏向在做、常做的。stop to do 和 stop doing 一字之差、两个方向，初中考试年年在这儿设题。
sections.metaphorStory: 银帆乐队的库房有条铁规矩，管库房的乐务老师天天挂在嘴边：「动作不能直接上货架——你总不能把正在扑腾的『游泳』塞进箱子吧？要入库，先打包：动词贴上 -ing 封条，动作就变成一件安安静静的东西。」Swimming is fun.——打包好的「游泳」稳稳当当坐在主语的位置上。团员们排队来打包：enjoy 的货架只收打包件（enjoy singing），finish 也是（finish cleaning）；介词这扇小门更严，at、of、for 后面不打包根本进不去：good at drawing、thanks for coming。鼓手小北问：「那 to do 和 doing 怎么分？」老师说：「to do 是还没上演的节目单——想做、打算做；doing 是已经在手里的活儿——在做、常做。」最后他压低声音：「最要小心的是 stop：stop doing 是把手里的活儿停掉，stop to do 是停下手头去干别的——一字之差，方向相反。」

cards.detail: 拼写三小规则与 G07 相同：去 e 加 ing（make→making）、短元音双写（run→running）、ie 变 y（lie→lying）。

cards.rule: 打包件能当主语，谓语按单数算
cards.detail: 动作打包后坐进主语位，整个包裹算一件东西——谓语用单数。
cards.example: Reading before bed helps you sleep.

cards.detail: enjoy / finish / practise / keep / mind / miss——多半是「在做、常做」的事。
at / in / of / for / about / without + doing——这扇门不收原形也不收 to do。
cards.example: She is good at painting. / Thanks for coming.

cards.rule: to do vs doing：节目单 vs 手里的活
cards.detail: want / hope / decide / plan + to do（还没做）；enjoy / finish / practise + doing（在做、常做）；like / love / start 两个都收。
cards.example: I want to swim. / I enjoy swimming.

cards.detail: stop doing 停止做，stop to do 停下来去做；remember/forget to do 记得（忘了）去做——还没做；remember/forget doing 记得（忘了）做过——已发生。
cards.example: Stop talking! / He stopped to answer the phone.

basic.cn: 游泳是我最喜欢的运动。（打包件当主语）

basic.en: I enjoy listening to music after dinner.
She finished cleaning her room at noon.

basic.cn: 谢谢你帮我。（介词 for 后打包）

basic.en: He is good at telling stories.

mid.en: Keep practising and you will get better.
mid.cn: 坚持练习，你会越来越好。

mid.en: Would you mind opening the window?
mid.cn: 你介意开一下窗吗？（mind + doing）

mid.en: Getting up early is a good habit.
mid.cn: 早起是个好习惯。（主语打包，谓语单数）

mid.en: We talked about going camping next week.
mid.cn: 我们聊了下周去露营的事。（about 后打包）

mid.en: My little brother is afraid of sleeping alone.

trap.en: Stop talking — the concert is starting.
trap.cn: 别说话了——音乐会开始了。
trap.note: stop doing＝停止讲话；stop to talk 就成了「停下来去聊天」。

trap.en: Remember to lock the door when you leave.
trap.note: remember to do＝记得去做（还没做）。

trap.en: I remember visiting this museum when I was five.
trap.cn: 我记得五岁时来过这家博物馆。
trap.note: 记得做过——已经发生，用 doing。
without 是介词——后面只收打包件。

trap.en: Running in the hallway is not allowed.
trap.note: 打包件当主语，谓语用单数 is。

trap.en: She likes swimming, but today she'd like to swim in the new pool.
trap.cn: 她一向喜欢游泳，今天想去新泳池游。
trap.note: like doing 是长期爱好；would like to do 是此刻想做——一词之差。

redBlack.bad: Remember posting the letter tomorrow.（想说：明天记得寄信）
redBlack.good: Remember to post the letter tomorrow.
redBlack.why: remember doing 是「记得寄过」——信还没寄呢，听的人以为寄完了，明天的事就黄了。

redBlack.bad: I forgot bringing my homework — it's at home.（想说：忘带作业了）
redBlack.good: I forgot to bring my homework — it's at home.
redBlack.why: forgot doing 是「忘了曾经带过」——作业到底带没带，意思全说反了。
enjoy 的货架只收 -ing 打包件。

redBlack.bad: She finished to write the letter.
redBlack.why: finish 只收打包件——写完的活儿已经在手里。
for 是介词——后面只收打包件。
at 是介词——原形进不了这扇门。

redBlack.bad: Swim is good for your health.
redBlack.good: Swimming is good for your health.
redBlack.why: 动作要打包成 -ing 才能坐主语的位置。

redBlack.bad: Would you mind close the door?
redBlack.good: Would you mind closing the door?

redBlack.why: keep + doing＝保持做——手里的活别撒手。
打包件当主语算一件东西——谓语用单数（G25 的声部对齐）。

redBlack.bad: I like to swim. / I like swimming.（有人说必须二选一）
redBlack.why: like / love / start 两种包装都收——泛指爱好时 doing 更常见，考试不设坑。

redBlack.bad: It's no use to cry over spilt milk.（有人这么写）
redBlack.good: It's no use crying over spilt milk.
redBlack.why: no use / no good 后习惯接 doing——记住套话即可，说错也不挡意思。

contrast.cn: 游泳很有趣。（「游泳」直接当名词）
contrast.diff: 中文动作天生能当东西；英语要先加 -ing 打包封箱。

contrast.en: I like drawing. / I like to draw.
contrast.diff: 中文一种说法；英语两种包装 like 都收——不用纠结。
英语介词后面只收打包件——for come 进不了门。
中文靠「别……了」；英语 stop + 打包件＝把手里的活停掉。

contrast.cn: 记得关灯。／我记得关过灯。（「记得」一样）
contrast.en: Remember to turn off the light. / I remember turning off the light.
contrast.diff: 英语用 to do / doing 区分「还没做」和「已做过」——中文全靠上下文。

quickJudge.mnemonic: 动作当东西，先打 -ing 包；介词后只收包裹；enjoy 收包 want 看单；stop 接谁方向反。
steps: 动作要当主语或宾语？先打包：动词 + -ing（过一遍拼写三小规则）。
前面是介词（at / in / of / for / about / without）？只收打包件。
enjoy / finish / practise / keep / mind → 接 doing。
want / hope / decide / plan → 接 to do（回 G30）。
like / love / start 两个都收，别纠结。
stop / remember / forget 先问「做了没有」：还没做 to do，已做或在做 doing。

parentScript.script: 「宝贝，中文说『游泳很有趣』，『游泳』直接当东西用；英语得先给动作打个包——贴上 -ing 封条：Swimming is fun. 咱们玩『打包上架』：你说三样喜欢做的事，都用 I enjoy ...ing 说出来——enjoy 这个货架只收打包好的。再玩『寄信游戏』分清 to 和 -ing：Remember to post the letter 是『记得去寄』，信还没寄；I remember posting it 是『我记得寄过』，信已经寄了。我不懂英语没关系，我只听两件事：enjoy、finish 后面的词有没有 -ing 的尾音；说『记得去做什么』的时候，有没有 to 的音。说错了咱不批评，把包重新打一遍就行。」
questions: 「游泳很有趣」翻成英语，「游泳」要先做什么处理？
enjoy 和 want 后面各接哪种包装？
stop talking 和 stop to talk 差在哪儿？

sections.echo: 同一个动词的第二张脸：加 -ing 打包，动作就冻结成一件「东西」——照样不报时。G30 的 to do 是节目单（指向将来），本课的 doing 是手里的活（进行与习惯），下一课 G32 的 -ing/-ed 还要给动作当形容词用。三张脸三套规则，背后是同一个原则：报时权只属于主奏，其余动词形态一律冻结——像同一位乐手，换一件乐器就得守另一套指法。三张脸的正面交锋，留在精修层 G46。

memoryCard.alt: G31 记忆卡：动词+-ing 打包成东西，能当主语（谓语单数）、当宾语、进介词的门；enjoy/finish/practise/keep/mind 只收打包件，want/hope/decide 接 to do，like/love/start 两可；stop/remember/forget 接谁意思变；警示 enjoy to play、good at sing、Thanks for help me、Reading books make。

questions.q: 动名词的样子是？
questions.explain: 贴上 -ing 封条，动作变成东西。

questions.q: Swimming is fun. 里 Swimming 当的是？
questions.explain: 打包好的「游泳」坐在主语位上。

questions.q: 动名词报时间吗？
questions.explain: 报时权只属于主奏动词。

questions.q: enjoy 后面接？
questions.explain: enjoy 的货架只收打包件。

questions.q: finish 后面接？
practise 后面接？
questions.explain: 练习是反复在做的事——practise doing。

questions.q: 介词（at / for / without）后面的动词要用？
make 打包成动名词是？
run 打包成动名词是？
questions.explain: 短元音 + 单辅音先双写——running。

questions.q: lie（躺）打包成动名词是？
questions.explain: ie 变 y 再加 ing——lying。

questions.q: want 后面接？
questions.explain: 想做的事还没做——节目单 to do。

questions.q: like 后面接？
options: to do 和 doing 都行
questions.explain: like / love / start 两种包装都收。

questions.q: mind（介意）后面接？
「谢谢你帮我」说成 Thanks for ___ me.
questions.explain: for 是介词——打包件 helping。

questions.q: 动名词当主语时，谓语用？
questions.explain: 一个包裹算一件东西——单数。

questions.q: keep（保持做）后面接？
___ is my favourite sport.
I enjoy ___ to music after dinner.
She finished ___ her room at noon.
He is good at ___ stories.
Keep ___ and you will get better.
Would you mind ___ the window?
___ up early is a good habit.
questions.explain: 打包件当主语——Getting up early。

questions.q: We talked about ___ camping next week.
My brother is afraid of ___ alone.
He left without ___ goodbye.
Stop ___! The film has started.
Remember ___ the door when you leave.
I remember ___ this museum when I was five.
Thank you for ___ to my birthday party.
___ books every day makes you smart.
questions.explain: 打包件当主语，谓语 makes 单数。

questions.q: How about ___ football this afternoon?
哪一句包装对了？（我喜欢下棋——用 enjoy）
哪一句包装对了？（她写完信了）
options: She finished to write the letter.

questions.q: 哪一句包装对了？（谢谢你帮我）
哪一句包装对了？（他很会唱歌）
options: He is good at to sing.

questions.q: 哪一句包装对了？（游泳对健康有好处）
options: Swimming is good for your health.
Swim is good for your health.
To swimming is good for your health.

questions.q: 哪一句包装对了？（你介意关门吗）
options: Would you mind closing the door?
Would you mind close the door?
Would you mind to close the door?

questions.q: 哪一句包装对了？（每天坚持练习）
哪一句包装对了？（读书使人聪明）
哪一句包装对了？（走廊里不许跑）
options: Running in the hallway is not allowed.
Run in the hallway is not allowed.
To running in the hallway is not allowed.

questions.q: 哪一句包装对了？（他没说再见就走了）
options: He left without to say goodbye.

questions.q: 哪一句包装对了？（明天记得寄信——还没寄）
options: Remember to post the letter tomorrow.

questions.q: 哪一句包装对了？（我记得去过那家动物园）
options: I remember going to that zoo.
I remember to go to that zoo.
I remember went to that zoo.

questions.q: 哪一句包装对了？（他不再抱怨了）
哪一句包装对了？（聊聊去野餐的事）
options: Let's talk about having a picnic.
Let's talk about have a picnic.
Let's talk about to have a picnic.

questions.q: 哪一句包装对了？（何不再试一次）
哪一句包装对了？（弹钢琴是她的爱好）
options: Playing the piano is her hobby.
Play the piano is her hobby.
To playing the piano is her hobby.

stages.name: 用一用 · 两种包装同台

questions.q: I enjoy ___, but today I don't want ___ in the cold river.
She stopped ___ TV because it was time ___ dinner.
questions.explain: 停止看电视 stop doing；It's time to do。

questions.q: Remember ___ off the lights before ___ the music room.
questions.explain: 还没做 remember to do；before 介词接 doing。

questions.q: He is afraid of ___ mistakes, so he practises ___ English aloud every day.
— How about ___ a kite? — Good idea! I'd like ___ one with you.
questions.explain: How about doing；would like to do。

questions.q: My sister keeps ___ the violin, and she hopes ___ the school orchestra.
Thanks for ___ to help me — I finally finished ___ the model.
I forgot ___ my umbrella, but I clearly remember ___ it by the door this morning.
questions.explain: 忘了去带（没带成）to do；记得放过（已发生）doing。

questions.q: ___ vegetables is good for you, but my brother isn't interested in ___ them.
questions.explain: 主语打包 Eating；in 介词 + eating。

questions.q: The boy practised ___ every day and finally he was able ___ across the pool.
Would you mind ___ more slowly? I'm not good at ___ fast English.
He spent the whole afternoon ___ his bike without ___ a rest.
Stop ___ about the test — let's practise ___ old papers instead.
— Do you feel like ___ out tonight? — Sorry, I have a report ___.
questions.explain: feel like + doing；a report to write（G30 的名词小尾巴）。

questions.q: The old man enjoys ___ his flowers and never forgets ___ them in the morning.
questions.explain: enjoy doing；每天的任务别忘了去做——forget to do。

questions.q: 大考：___ the drum is fun, but my neighbours mind me ___ it at night, so I promised ___ only in the daytime.
questions.explain: 打包当主语 Playing；mind + doing；promise + to do——三个座位各就各位。

detective.sentence: I enjoy to read comic books on weekends.
detective.fixed: I enjoy reading comic books on weekends.
detective.clue: enjoy 的货架只收 -ing 打包件。

detective.sentence: She is good at play the piano.
detective.fixed: She is good at playing the piano.
detective.clue: at 是介词——后面只收打包件。

detective.sentence: Swim in the sea is exciting.
detective.fixed: Swimming in the sea is exciting.
detective.clue: 动作要打包成 -ing 才能坐主语的位置。

detective.sentence: Thank you for invite me to the party.
detective.fixed: Thank you for inviting me to the party.
detective.clue: for 是介词——inviting 才进得了这扇门。

detective.sentence: Would you mind to turn down the music?
detective.fixed: Would you mind turning down the music?

detective.sentence: Remember posting the letter tomorrow, or Grandma won't get it.
detective.fixed: Remember to post the letter tomorrow, or Grandma won't get it.
detective.clue: 信还没寄——「记得去做」用 remember to do；doing 成了「记得寄过」。

detective.sentence: Eating too many sweets are bad for your teeth.
detective.fixed: Eating too many sweets is bad for your teeth.
detective.clue: 打包件当主语算一件东西——谓语用单数 is。
